description: Move `admin` (incl. `admin-core` + `admin-user` + `docs-admin`) handlers/services into `scenarios/landing-page-business-suite/api/domain/admin/` with exported `RegisterRoutes(router, deps)`. Update `routes.go` to call `admin.RegisterRoutes` instead of `registerAdminCoreRoutes` + `registerAdminUserRoutes` + `registerDocsRoutes`. Decision point: the `deploy-readiness` route is admin-gated but spans downloads+remote-profile+plans — the dep-graph research must say whether it lives here, in `downloads`, or stays at the top-level composer. `requireAdminOrService` middleware should be available to all subpackages (likely surfaced via the shared package designed in the research item). Behavior-preserving: admin auth, user mgmt, doc admin endpoints unchanged. Acceptance: tests pass; `api/domain/admin` package exists; old register functions removed; no cycles.
